title: Robert's Renault Twingo First Drive, Carpool Style!
summary:
We take the new Renault Twingo for a first drive around London with Renault brand CEO Fabrice Cambolive.

The Twingo arrives in the UK very early next year. We got behind the wheel of a left-hand drive car ahead of the right-hand drive models. We chatted about the Paris Motor Show, the success of the Renault 5, Renault’s plans for the next few years and how Europe can compete with Chinese car makers, all at a strict 20mph!

title: The New 2CV Could Cost Just £13,000!
summary:
The Citroën 2CV is BACK, and it's electric! 🇫🇷⚡

We're at the Paris Motor Show for a first look at Citroën's reborn 2CV. It's a small, light, affordable electric car that brings back one of the most loved designs in motoring history! Pitched at around €15,000 (about £13,000), which undercuts some of the cheapest Chinese electric cars, and it's due to go on sale to the public in 2028!!!

And that's not all. We also take a look at plenty more from the show, including the Leapmotor B03, the Fiat Multipla concept, the Lotus Evija, a Peugeot concept with drive-by-wire steering, the new electric Renault Espace, the self-driving Xpeng L3, and BYD's 1.5 megawatt flash charger!
